input.description: Authorize live fixes to Lean build errors
input.prompt:
Update from Lando, while you're running: "any lean build errors that may arise are yours to correct immediately." This extends your task — if `lake build` (or however p4rakernel actually builds) turns up real compile errors, not `sorry` warnings, not axiom notices, but genuine build failures, fix them directly in the source, right now, and rebuild to confirm the fix actually closes it, the same way I fixed a real bug in native_numeral.rs earlier this session (found it, patched it, rebuilt, reverified against the original failing cases). Don't just log an error and move on.

Keep the reporting standard from before: no rounding, no "sorry-free," exact sorry count, exact axiom census on the load-bearing theorems, and now also an exact account of what build errors you found and fixed (file, what was wrong, what you changed) versus what you found and could not safely fix (say why, don't guess a fix you're not sure of). If the build was already clean, say that plainly and move on to the sorry/axiom census as originally scoped.
